title: Evidence record
description: One line of records.ndjson in an evidence/v1 export: one append-only Record of a change's evidence chain (canon_version 2). Not expressible here and checked by the verifier: the line is the canonical JSON form of the record (sorted keys, no whitespace, no HTML escapes, one newline); record_hash, previous_record_hash and signature re-derive from the other fields; sequences are contiguous from 1; sequence 1 has no previous_record_hash and every later record has one; sandbox_profile and sandbox_image_digest are both present or both absent; a capability action carries policy_decision_id and, unless denied, grant_id; lifecycle only on a succeeded lifecycle edge action; at most 1024 inputs and 1024 outputs; executor_id and model_id are at most 256 bytes of valid UTF-8 without control characters or leading or trailing space; action is at most 128 bytes and the lifecycle major version at most 2^31-1; the record is at most 3 MiB.

executor_id.description: Executor identity; free text of at most 256 bytes. Absent when no executor was involved; an empty string is never emitted.

model_id.description: Model identity; free text of at most 256 bytes. Absent when no model was involved; an empty string is never emitted.

inputs.description: At most 1024 artifacts; absent when there are none. The ref of a NetworkRequests.v1 request line (receipt/request/...) has ten slash-separated fields, or eleven when the last is the literal injected (added in 1.1.0); the verifier checks it (docs/evidence/receipts.md).

outputs.description: At most 1024 artifacts; absent when there are none. The ref of a NetworkRequests.v1 request line (receipt/request/...) has ten slash-separated fields, or eleven when the last is the literal injected (added in 1.1.0); the verifier checks it (docs/evidence/receipts.md).

canon_version.description: The record canonical-form version; 2 in evidence/v1.

digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: the prefix sha256: and 64 lowercase hex characters.

sequence.description: 1-based position in the chain, at most 2^53-1 so that verifiers that parse numbers as floats keep it exact.

action.description: A capability name port.verb (lowercase port, one dot, lowercase snake_case verb), a tool capability tool.<plugin>.<name> of the tool gateway (the plugin is one lowercase DNS label, the name lowercase snake_case), or a versioned lifecycle event name such as ChangeOpened.v1.

principalName.description: Printable ASCII, no leading or trailing space, at most 256 bytes (the length bound is not expressible here).

actorKind.description: Agent kinds (author-agent, reviewer-agent) must carry actor_run_id; the schema cannot express that. broker and egress-proxy author the receipt records of docs/evidence/receipts.md and nothing else.

sandboxProfile.description: microvm is reserved on the wire; no adapter emits it.

timestamp.description: RFC 3339 in UTC in Go's form: Z suffix, no offset, an optional fraction of 1 to 9 digits whose last digit is not 0 (a fraction of all zeros is omitted). Year 0000 and impossible calendar days (such as 02-30) are not excluded by the pattern; the verifier rejects them.

signature.description: An Ed25519 signature: 64 raw bytes as standard padded base64, 88 characters ending ==. Present only with signing_key_id and record_hash.

ref.description: A reference of at most 1024 bytes with no .. path segment; the length bound and the segment rule are not expressible here.

lifecycle.description: The lifecycle edge a change-edge record receipts. Accepted only on a succeeded record of a lifecycle edge action.
